I weigh myself multiple times a day. If the number is even half a pound higher, it ruins everything—I’ll skip the next meal or walk laps around my condo. I’ve turned down dinners with friends and even drinks with clients because the idea of unexpected calories makes me so anxious I can’t think straight.

    C. Bulimia Nervosa
    D. Specific Phobia
